newsitem.title: HONG KONG: RESEARCH ALERT - Goldman 1997 stock picks for Asia.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Goldman 1997 stock picks for Asia.

text.p: Goldman Sachs said it had picked six Hong Kong stocks which should represent "outstanding opportunities" this year, as part of a list of 12 stocks which the firm considers the best stock investments in Asia in 1997.

In a January 17 report, Goldman said its picks for Asia included Asia Satellite Telecommunications Co Ltd, HSBC Holdings Plc, Hutchison Whampoa Ltd, National Mutual Asia Ltd, Regal Hotels International Holdings Ltd and Television Broadcasts Ltd.

Other Asian stocks on the list were India's Hindalco Industries Ltd, Indonesia's Indo-Rama Synthetics and Semen Gresik, Singapore's Far East Levingston Shipbuilding Ltd and United Overseas Bank and Thailand's Thai Farmers Bank Plc.
"We are reasonably upbeat about overall prospects for Asian equity markets in 1997, with expected 12-month returns averaging about 16 percent," Goldman said.

"Our positive expectations are based on improving export growth, a fairly benign U.S. interest rate outlook and modest valuations, with most regional markets now trading below their five-year historic average," it added.
